_doc: Machine SSOT for FireKaro's WhatsApp templates, consumed by the global skill /wati-template-create-and-track (it submits each non-approved template to Wati -> Meta and polls to approval). Human-readable companion: docs/whatsapp-templates.md (generated/reference only — edit THIS file, not the markdown). Meta rules enforced: (1) body MUST NOT end with a variable — static text after the last {{n}}; (2) UTILITY = transactional/account-specific (delivers reliably); MARKETING = engagement (per-user capped, needs marketingOptIn). Variables are positional {{1}}..{{n}}; `variables[]` order MUST match the {{n}} positions and supplies Meta approval samples (-> Wati customParams).
